say.speaker: combee
say.text: Good morning, {name:healer}! We traced the warm updraft from the ridge and found golden clover blooming behind camp! ...Yeah, golden clover!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Golden clover this high up? No wonder my blossom kept tilting east while we marched!

say.speaker: combee
say.text: We shook a little dust off the outer petals for you. Left wing carried the dry pollen, right wing grabbed the dewdrop... and the bottom of us dropped the dewdrop.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Hehe, thank you anyway, all three of you. Here, let me brush the loose grains into your honeycomb pocket before the wind steals them.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Whoa, your touch cooled our wings right down! How did you keep those petals so crisp without a drop of spring water? ...Yeah, how?!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Just shade them with a leaf when the sun bites too hard. Next break, you show us where that clover grows, and I will teach you how to spot the freshest buds.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Hold still a second, {name:combee}. You caught soot on your wingtips scouting through that dry pass.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Sorry, {name:healer}! We hovered too close to a wild ember trap, and the bottom of us tried to sneeze it out... which only blew ash everywhere.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Good thing you brought back sweet nectar from the valley yesterday. Dab a tiny drop along a scorched wing and it seals the cracks like tree sap.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Wait, our own honey works as salve?! We always just ate it between marches! ...Wait, we can use it for wings too?!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Mix it with crushed mint leaf and it calms bruises twice as fast. My mom taught me that trick back home whenever my brother scraped his knees.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Then we have a deal! We scout every wildflower patch ahead of the squad, and you turn our harvest into medicine! ...Into medicine!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Deal! With scouts like you in the canopy, nobody in this company will ever run short of salve.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: {name:combee}, why did you dive in front of that stone volley earlier? Your lower wing is trembling.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Ow, easy on the left edge... A pebble clipped your stem while you were healing the front line, so we banked across before the second rock hit.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: You took the blow for a single petal? If one of you gets hurt badly, all three of you feel it.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: That's why we move fast. Back at the hive, if a frost wind hits one flowerbed, the whole swarm crowds around to warm it. ...Yeah, we don't leave blooms behind.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Even when the road gets meaner than our village woods... you still hover right beside me.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Besides, who else lets us nap on a soft blossom between turns? We're sticking near you all the way to the finish, {name:healer}.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Then stay close enough to hear my bell-chime, okay? Whenever you pull back hurt, my healing light goes to you first.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Look at that sky, {name:healer}. Even out here near scarred ground, a tiny blue bud poked straight through the gravel! ...Right through the gravel!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: And look at all the pollen clinging to your fur. Everywhere we have marched since the watering hole, you have been planting seeds without even noticing.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Wait, really? We thought we were just snacking on the fly! ...Wait, we planted a trail?

say.speaker: healer
say.text: When this Rift trouble is finally sealed and the roads open back up, every camp we left behind is going to bloom.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Hey, {name:healer}. Once the war ends, will you fly out past the village with us? Half the ridges out there still need fresh meadows.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Count on it. Wing and petal, from the first spring morning to every hillside after. Neither of us flies a meadow alone again.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: All three of us heard that promise, and not even the bottom one lagged! Wing and petal partners for life!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Hmph! Brace the shoulders, lock both knees, never give a single pace! Right, Master {name:mentor}?

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Stand like a gatepost, young {name:chespin}, and a charging rhino will tip you over like a barrel. Watch your left heel.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Whoa! One tap with your feather fan spun my whole shell sideways! How did you break my stance so easily?

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Because you met force head-on. Turn your shoulder ten degrees, sink your weight into the back foot, and let their blow slide off your armor.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Ten degrees... sink the back heel... Wait. That feels lighter! Almost like dancing in iron!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Footwork keeps armor alive, squire. Practice that pivot twenty times before supper, and tomorrow no raider on the ridge moves you.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Master {name:mentor}, I held the narrow pass today, yet when a second attacker flanked right, I nearly lost my balance stepping back.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: You hesitated because you thought a knight should never retreat a single step. Am I right?

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Yes, sir. On the foothill trail, I swore to stand like a wall. Giving ground felt like breaking my oath.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: In the Royal Guard, we had a saying: yield an inch with your feet so your comrades keep a mile behind you. Stubbornness gets your flank broken.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Wait... so sliding half a pace back to line up both foes in front of my shell is actually good guard work?

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: The very finest kind. A wall never thinks, {name:chespin}. A knight moves so the line never tears.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Yield an inch to hold a mile. I will drill that step until my boots wear thin!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Enough drills for tonight, {name:chespin}. Sit by the embers and catch your breath.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Did I miss my pivot on that last sweep, Master {name:mentor}? I felt my back heel lift.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Your heel stayed planted, and you parried three strikes I threw at full speed. That was no squire's stance.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Full speed?! You mean you weren't holding back anymore?

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Not once. Back when I served King Serperior, knights twice your size buckled under half that pressure. You belong in the Royal Guard.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Coming from you, sir... that means more than any royal medal.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: My knees won't carry the front line forever, {name:chespin}. Watch over my kids when the storms break ahead, and keep standing tall.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Upon my shell and my honor, Master {name:mentor}, nothing touches them while I am standing.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: All right, {name:chespin}! I split three pine logs before breakfast, so brace that shiny shell! Let's see if my punch can nudge you!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: I am ready whenever you are, {name:machop}. Strike right at the center crest.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hup-HAAAH! ...YOWCH! Ow, ow, ow! Did you swallow a boulder?! My knuckles feel like they hit a castle wall!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Are your fingers all right?! Wait... my boots didn't even slide an inch in the mud!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Shake it off, shake it off... Hmph! Okay, round one goes to the iron nut. Tomorrow I am bringing a heavier chop!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: First let our camp healer wrap your hand. Then you may test my armor every evening you like.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Not aiming straight at the crest this time! Watch the footwork, {name:chespin}, feint left, strike low!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Ha! Pivot ten degrees, sink the heel... and shoulder check!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Whoa! You caught my sweep mid-spin and bounced me right off your shoulder! When did you get that quick on the turn?

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Every time you lunge, you open my guard... and every time I pin you down, look at your stance. Anyone else behind me would be wide open.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hold on... Wait a second! If you soak the enemy's counter first and lock them right in front of you, I can vault straight past your shoulder!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Shield pins the gate, fist breaks the line. We should test that formation on the next march!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Now you're talking! No more punching each other's knuckles bruised, let's save the heavy swings for the raiders!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hey, hold still while I buff out that gouge on your backplate. That brute swung way harder than we expected.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: It is only a scratch, {name:machop}. You dropped him before his follow-up could land.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Almost wasn't fast enough, though. When I punch too deep into a pack, I never think about my own guard. You always cover my blind side.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: And when wild packs surround me, I tend to freeze and bunker down until my legs go numb. Hearing you shout 'break through!' snaps me right back awake.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Guess neither of us is complete on our own, huh? Funny how a mountain guide and a roadside squire fit like two halves of a warhammer.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Stay on my right shoulder tomorrow, {name:machop}. No wall holds us back when we push together.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Whew! Look at this old sparring mark on your shell, {name:chespin}. Still shows right where my fist bounced off the first night we met.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: I never polished it out. Kept it as a reminder that our vanguard never yields once we set our boots together.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Ha! Listen to us. Boss Machamp always told me a true fighter looks for a partner he can trust with his unguarded back.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Then let us make it formal, comrade. Through whatever kingdoms and rifts lie ahead of this expedition, I will always hold the gate beside you.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: And I will always shatter whatever tries to break your shield! And after peace returns, you are coming up to the mountain ridge to help me train the new guides!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Deal, brother-in-arms! Shield and spear, from this vanguard line to the very last mountain!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Frontline buddies forever! Bring on whatever army shows up next!

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Clack-clunk, clack-clunk! {name:chespin}, pal, any outpost within half a mile can hear you marching before we even crest the hill!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Let them hear me coming, {name:partner}. Better loud armor than twirling into an ambush with nothing guarding your ribs.

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Hey, my footwork isn't flashy! Watch: two quick hops, spin the crest smooth, and zero mud on the feathers!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: You just stepped on a loose pebble mid-spin and nearly sat in that puddle.

say.speaker: partner
say.text: That was a tactical crouch! Look, when you move faster than arrows, you don't need twenty pounds of chestnut plate!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Then show me how well speed holds when an enemy blocks the narrow bridge ahead. I will be right behind you to catch the bounce.

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Watch this flank dash, {name:chespin}! Left turn, slide right... wait, why did you step into that gap?!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Oof! Look out, {name:partner}! An archer had a bead on that gap, so I cut across!

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Ugh... my beak bounced clean off your backplate like a rubber ball. Good thing my crest stayed intact.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Forgive me! I bruised your wing with my heavy shell again.

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Are you kidding? That rebound launched me straight past the archer's guard! Maybe Dad's heavy-guard drills weren't all hot air.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: And I will admit your speed drew every eye away from the line. Fast feet need an anchor, and an anchor needs fast feet.

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Hah! Just give me a two-second whistle before you become a surprise wall next time, partner!

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Halt! Nobody take another step! ...I am stuck.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: {name:chespin}? Why are you standing on one foot like a statue in the middle of the path?

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: There is a clump of tiny white blossoms three inches ahead of my boot, {name:healer}. My armor weighs a ton! One wrong step and I will flatten them!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Oh, haha! Those are tough meadow daisies, silly! Even if a cart wheel rolled over them, they would spring right back up by dusk.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Truly? Wait, even your own blossom... whenever you drift close to me in camp, I hold my breath so my shoulder spikes never snag a petal.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: That is awfully sweet of a big knight! Just set your foot down gently around that rock, and we can both keep marching.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Oh no, the ridge gust is picking up! If this cold draft hits that rare frost-lily bud, the petals will wilt before I can gather its dew.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Say no more, {name:healer}. Tell me where to plant my boots without touching the roots.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Right on that flat slate stone to the west! Just kneel low so your shell cuts the wind.

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Like so? Not a single breeze can slip past the rim now. Take all the time your healing bottle needs.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Got every drop! Look how open the bloom stayed behind your shoulder. Armor is wonderful for more than blocking swords, isn't it?

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: A knight shields the frail as well as the fierce. Whenever you gather herbs on windy cliffs, call me first.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Excuse us! Hello? {name:slakoth}! The sun is straight overhead and the camp horn blew five minutes ago! ...Five minutes ago!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Mmph... five more minutes... sun feels nice on the moss right here...

say.speaker: combee
say.text: How can anyone sleep with six wings buzzing two inches above your ear?! Back at our hive, midday means thirty nectar runs before tea!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Sounds exhausting... You three keep flapping like that, you'll miss the best cloud shapes... Look, that one's a berry...

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Hold on, top-left says keep moving, top-right says he has a point, and... *yawn*... the bottom of us just nodded off watching that cloud!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: See...? One third of you already understands... Wake me when we reach the next shade tree...

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Okay, {name:slakoth}, we timed you for three whole days! Every afternoon at the exact same shadow length, you curl up for forty winks!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Mhmm... Keep your heartbeat slow... save every ounce of juice until you actually need to swing...

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Wait, so your naps aren't an accident? You schedule them like our Queen schedules hive shifts?! ...Like hive shifts!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Well... calling it a schedule makes me sleepy just thinking about it... Want to try sitting still for once?

say.speaker: combee
say.text: We brought warm honey-sap in an acorn cup! Let's try ten quiet minutes together. No buzzing, no scouting... okay, maybe soft humming.

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Sweet honey and soft humming... You three might be the best nap crew on this whole march...

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Rise and shine, {name:slakoth}! Dawn patrol means fifty mountain squats, twenty sprints, and boulder presses until your arms burn!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: *Yaaawn*... Too noisy, Coach {name:machop}... That big rock is blocking my sunbeam anyway...

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hey, that granite boulder weighs twice as much as you! Let's lift it together on three! One, two...

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Hup... There. Dropped it in the ditch. Nice and sunny now... Zzz...

say.speaker: machop
say.text: WHAT?! You tossed a four-hundred-pound boulder one-handed without even breaking a yawn?! Wait, wake up! Teach me your grip!!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Mmph... tell you after lunch... Zzz...

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Uh... {name:machop}? Why are you lying face-up on a flat rock staring at the sky? Are you hurt?

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Shh! Do not break my focus! I figured out your secret! You store power by doing zero movement! I am training total stillness right now!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Your left foot is tapping sixty times a minute... and your fists are still clenched tight...

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Gah! I can't help it! Lying still for three minutes hurts worse than climbing Mount Horn! How do you turn your muscles all the way off?!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Don't try so hard to relax... Just eat a berry and let gravity hold your shoulders...

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Forget it! I am going back to timber presses! But next time our camp hits a landslide, I am waking you first!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hey, {name:slakoth}. Keep sleeping if you want for five more minutes. I scoped out the ravine ahead, and there is a fallen granite slab blocking the wagons.

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Mmph... no morning drill speech today? No whistle?

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Took me a while to realize I don't need to train you into my rhythm. You carry mountain strength in your own quiet way.

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Heh... Appreciate the quiet, Coach. Point me at that granite slab so I can clear it before my afternoon nap.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Deal! You heave the slab clear so I can sprint ahead and scout the ridge. Nobody makes a better tag-team in the passes than us.

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: You run the fast miles, I'll move the heavy stones... Anytime you call, {name:machop}, I'll wake up for you.
